svg.aria-label: Animated CI/CD architecture: Terraform and Ansible provision Azure, GitHub triggers Jenkins through 8 real pipeline stages, the image goes to Docker Hub, Helm deploys to AKS, and a ServiceMonitor feeds Prometheus, Grafana and Alertmanager.
svg.text: Every value shown is read from this repo's own Jenkinsfile, terraform.tfvars, helm-chart/values.yaml, servicemonitor.yaml and monitoring/values.yaml.
